parts.name: DataTable
parts.description: A `<table>` with all of the values of the chart: one row per category or x value, and one column per series.

props.name: visibility
props.description:
`visible` shows the table. `screen-reader` keeps it only in the accessibility tree. The
default is `screen-reader`.

props.name: caption
props.description: The caption of the table. Without it, the `Chart.Title` names the table.

props.name: rowHeader
props.description:
The header of the first column. It is the column of the categories or of the x values. In a
table with a row per point, it is the column of the series. The default is the label or the
name of the field.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the table.

dataAttributes.name: data-rule
dataAttributes.description: On the row of each rule, in the `<tfoot>`.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: On the cell of the selected point, or on the row of a selected dot or slice.
